messages.text:
Good morning.

The device seems to be working fine.
It looks like it is just the screen that was having some issues.

What would be the steps?
Is it just replacing the device or is it replacing the screen?
Handed to the team · Replacement part has to be sent by a person; no RMA needed.

Note to the team: I sent this reply and flagged the case to the team (as a technical case) so they send a new screen for the Hammer Miner on order Shop····: Hello, Good news that the miner itself is working fine. That confirms the fault is only the small display module on top. The hashing board…

Note to the team: I sent this short reply. I didn't raise a new flag, because the request for the replacement screen is already with the team. Hello, You're welcome. The team will email you today to confirm the replacement screen for your Hammer Miner. Until then, keep the miner running as it is. …

handoffs: Replacement part has to be sent by a person; no RMA needed.
